title: Yulla Kanda Trek
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.

24 km round-trip trek, up to 13,500 ft

overview:
A short trek in Kinnaur: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** Yulla Kanda group trek leaves Delhi at night for an overnight journey to Tapri/Yulla. The trek is 24 km round trip, reaches a height of 13,500 ft and is rated easy to moderate.

Day 1 is for arriving, checking into the hotel and resting. On Day 2 you drive 30 minutes to Yulla Village and trek about 10 km (4–6 hours) to Yulla Base Camp, where you stay in tents. Day 3 starts with an early trek to the Krishna temple, known as the world's highest Krishna temple, then the walk back to Yulla Village and the evening departure for Delhi. Transport, one hotel night, one camping night, the listed meals and a trip captain are included. Prices start at ₹6,999 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.content:
Morning: arrive in Tapri/Yulla in the late morning.
Afternoon: check into your hotel, rest and prepare for the trek the following day.

itinerary.title: Trek from Yulla Village to Yulla Base Camp
itinerary.content:
Morning: after breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive to Yulla Village (30 minutes).
Daytime: begin the trek of approximately 10 km, which takes about 4–6 hours.
Have a packed lunch on the trail or on reaching the base camp.
Evening: dinner at the base camp and an overnight stay in camp tents.
Meals: breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Stay: camping at Yulla Base Camp.

itinerary.title: Trek to Krishna temple and return to Delhi
itinerary.content:
Morning: start early and trek to the Krishna temple, known as the world's highest Krishna temple.
Spend some time exploring the surroundings, then head back to the campsite for breakfast.
Afternoon: trek back to Yulla Village, then drive to Tapri and freshen up at the hotel.
Evening: depart for Delhi.
Meals: breakfast.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip departs from Delhi at night for an overnight journey to Tapri/Yulla in the Kinnaur district, arriving in the late morning. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.

faqs.q: How much does the Yulla Kanda Trek trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹6,999 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,499 on triple sharing and ₹7,999 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

All transfers from Delhi to Delhi by bus, Tempo Traveller or taxi, 1 night in a hotel at Tapri, 1 night camping at Yulla Kanda Base Camp, 2 breakfasts, 1 lunch and 2 dinners, a trip captain throughout and 24x7 customer support.

faqs.q: How long and how difficult is the trek?
faqs.a: The trek is 24 km round trip, reaches a height of 13,500 ft and is rated easy to moderate. The Day 2 walk from Yulla Village to the base camp is approximately 10 km and takes about 4–6 hours.

faqs.q: Do I have to carry my own backpack?
faqs.a: Offloading is not part of the package. If you want your backpack carried, the offloading fee is ₹250 per day per bag.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
